arguments.description:
Create a single solo portrait of ONLY the woman from the reference couple photo. Same person identity, face, hair, expression, clothing, and lighting must match the reference exactly.

Subject: Asian woman with fair skin, long wavy black hair parted on her left, hair falling over her left shoulder. White square-neck short puff-sleeve blouse. Calm neutral expression, looking at camera. Framed chest-up, centered as a formal ID/commemorative solo portrait.

CRITICAL overlap fix: In the original she stands next to a man whose right shoulder covers part of her left arm. Reconstruct her complete left shoulder, upper arm, and white puff sleeve naturally against the background. No man's vest, shirt, tie, hair, or body remnant. Her hair and white sleeve must look continuous and photorealistic with soft studio lighting.

Background: solid deep red studio backdrop, same color as reference. Even bright studio lighting. Photorealistic, not illustration. No text, watermark, or second person.

Create a single solo portrait of ONLY the man from the reference couple photo. Same person identity, face, hair, expression, clothing, and lighting must match the reference exactly.

Subject: Asian man with fair skin, short neatly styled black hair. White dress shirt, light patterned beige/tan tie, beige vest with a dark button. Slight pleasant smile, looking at camera. Framed chest-up, centered as a formal ID/commemorative solo portrait.

CRITICAL overlap fix: In the original a woman stands on his right (viewer's left); her arm and hair partly hide his right shoulder. Reconstruct his complete right shoulder, the right side of the beige vest, and white shirt sleeve naturally against the background. No woman's hair, white blouse, or body remnant. Vest edge and shoulder line must look continuous and photorealistic with soft studio lighting.

Background: solid deep red studio backdrop, same color as reference. Even bright studio lighting. Photorealistic, not illustration. No text, watermark, or second person.
